lessons.title: 成真 (chéngzhēn) — to become reality (of a wish)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for of one's own free will, then the Mandarin for let us hope that.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: 成真

segments.text: 成真 — chéngzhēn — "to become reality (of a wish)".
希望我的愿望能成真 xīwàng wǒ de yuànwàng néng chéngzhēn — I hope my wish comes true.

成真 (chéngzhēn) is built from 成 'to become' and 真 'true', both inherited from Middle Chinese, dzyeng and tsyin (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second as the true against the false.
One more word for saying what would happen.

Before the new one: say the Mandarin for let us hope that, then the Mandarin for to become reality.
yuánmèng — "to fulfil a dream".
rúguǒ míngnián néng qù Zhōngguó wǒ jiù yuánmèng le — If I can go to China next year, my dream will have come true.
Its characters come later; for now it is a word for the ear.

yuánmèng is built from yuán 'round, whole' and mèng 'a dream', both inherited from Middle Chinese, hjwen and mjuwngH (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second, after an older dictionary, as waking within sleep: a dream made whole.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.title: měihǎo — fine and happy (of a life or a future)
lessons.gloss: fine and happy (of a life or a future)

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for to become reality, then the Mandarin for to fulfil a dream.
měihǎo — "fine and happy (of a life or a future)".
zhǐyào dàjiā nǔlì shēnghuó jiù huì gèng měihǎo — As long as everyone works hard, life will get better.
Its characters come later; for now it is a word for the ear.
Two third tones meet in this word: měi is said with a rising tone before hǎo, and the spelling keeps both marks.

měihǎo is built from měi 'beautiful' and 好 'good', both inherited from Middle Chinese, mijX and xawX (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the first 'good-looking' and, after an older dictionary, 'sweet', and the second 'good, beautiful'.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.gloss: to dream of; to see in a dream

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for to fulfil a dream, then the Mandarin for fine and happy.
mèngjiàn — "to dream of; to see in a dream".
wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang mèngjiàn wǒ zhòngjiǎng le — Last night I dreamt I had won a prize.
Its characters come later; for now it is a word for the ear.
mèngjiàn is built from mèng 'a dream' and 见 'to see', both inherited from Middle Chinese, mjuwngH and kenH (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription), which glosses the second 'to look'.
One more word for saying what would happen.

lessons.title: pàntou — something to look forward to

segments.text: Before the new one: say the Mandarin for fine and happy, then the Mandarin for to see in a dream.
pàntou — "something to look forward to".
yǒu le gōngzuò shēnghuó jiù yǒu pàntou le — With a job, life has something to look forward to.
Its characters come later; for now it is a word for the ear.

pàntou is built from pàn 'to long for' and 头, both inherited from Middle Chinese, pheanH and duw (Guangyun, in Baxter's transcription). The dictionary glosses the first as beautiful eyes; the sense 'to long for' is not given there. The second, 'the head', is said light here, as at the end of other nouns.
One more word for saying what would happen.

segments.source: [YOU READ: 望 希 愿 — each one aloud, then a word that holds it]

segments.text: With good hopes of it? (有望, yǒuwàng.) To be dying to? (bābude.) To expect much of someone? (期望, qīwàng.) As one would wish it? (如意, rúyì.) To count on someone? (zhǐwàng.) To yearn for? (xiàngwǎng.) To hope that? (希望, xīwàng.) To thirst for? (kěwàng.) To give up all hope? (juéwàng.) May your wishes all come true? (心想事成, xīnxiǎng shìchéng.) Would rather? (nìngkě.) As far as one can? (jǐnliàng.) Supposing that? (假如, jiǎrú.) To give one's word? (xǔnuò.) May all go as you wish? (万事如意, wànshì rúyì.) To be willing? (愿意, yuànyì.) A wish one has? (愿望, yuànwàng.) To get what one wished for? (如愿, rúyuàn.) Of one's own free will? (自愿, zìyuàn.) Let us hope that? (但愿, dànyuàn.) To become reality? (成真, chéngzhēn.) To fulfil a dream? (yuánmèng.) Fine and happy? (měihǎo.) To see in a dream? (mèngjiàn.) Something to look forward to? (pàntou.)
